description.value: Take Five Cafe is a Metro Vancouver specialty coffee chain founded in 2003, now franchised across multiple locations including North Vancouver, serving espresso-based drinks made with specialty-grade Arabica beans alongside Italian-inspired lunches, freshly baked pastries, and seasonal specialties. The cafe's full food menu — paninis, wraps, salads, scones, and sweet treats — makes it a substantial stop rather than just a coffee grab. A customer review notes outdoor seating and friendly staff at this location.
